description: This file defines constants, macros, structures, and includes platform-specific headers for the ATM driver PPE registers in a network device. It contains register addresses, bitfield definitions, and data structures related to ATM and PPE hardware components.

classes.name: qsb_queue_parameter_table
classes.description: Union representing queue parameter table with bitfields for big-endian and little-endian architectures.

classes.name: qsb_queue_vbr_parameter_table
classes.description: Union representing VBR queue parameter table with bitfields for big-endian and little-endian architectures.

classes.name: SFSM_dba
classes.description: Structure representing a data bank address with reserved bits.

classes.name: SFSM_cba
classes.description: Structure representing a control bank address with reserved bits.

classes.name: SFSM_cfg
classes.description: Configuration structure for SFSM with various control bits.

classes.name: SFSM_pgcnt
classes.description: Structure for page count with control bits.

classes.name: FFSM_dba
classes.description: Structure representing a data bank address for FFSM.

classes.name: FFSM_cfg
classes.description: Configuration structure for FFSM with control bits.

classes.name: FFSM_pgcnt
classes.description: Structure for page count in FFSM with control bits.

methods.name: PPE_REG_ADDR
methods.description: Macro or function to get register address.

methods.name: GET_BITS
methods.description: Macro or function to extract specific bits from a register value.

methods.name: SET_BITS
methods.description: Macro or function to set specific bits in a register value.
